svg.title: Three Days of Keeper Silence: Why Missing Heartbeats Must Breach
svg.desc: How three bugs combined to make the ClickHouse Keeper liveness alarm blind for three days: a systemd service shipped without its timer, a dropped PutMetricData call, and CloudWatch treat_missing_data=missing hiding the silence as INSUFFICIENT_DATA.

g.text: Three Days of Keeper Silence: Why Self-Reported Heartbeats Must Breach on Missing Data
When the monitored process pushes its own heartbeat, silence is not "insufficient data" — silence is the failure
HOW THE ALARM WENT BLIND (INSUFFICIENT_DATA)
THE FAIL-LOUD HEARTBEAT CONTRACT
Bug 1: A Oneshot Service with No Timer
The bash-to-Go port installed keeper-health.service
but forgot keeper-health.timer. The probe ran once at boot
and never executed again.
Boot log looked green · Day-2 schedule did not exist
Fix 1: Pair Service + Timer by Construction
chinit installs keeper-health.service + keeper-health.timer
(every 1 minute) via the shared unit-pair helper and
asserts timer enablement in the role conformance test.
Schedules are part of the code contract, not optional metadata
Bug 2: The Metric Push Evaporated & Key Drifted
The Go probe parsed mntr and logged to journald, but
dropped the PutMetricData(keeper_up) call — and the
alarm dimension (Cluster vs Host) had no shared constant.
Zero datapoints reached CloudWatch after the rollout
Fix 2: In-Process CloudWatch Publish & Exact Key
chinit keeper-health pushes ClickHouse/Keeper keeper_up=1|0
via the cloud provider SDK with the exact Cluster dimension
expected by the Terraform alarm definition.
End-to-end verification: alarm must flip to OK on live data
Bug 3: treat_missing_data = "missing" Hid the Outage
With default missing semantics, zero datapoints moved
the alarm to gray INSUFFICIENT_DATA instead of ALARM.
A dead Keeper cannot push keeper_up = 0 either!
3 days of total monitoring blindness with zero pages
Fix 3: treat_missing_data = "breaching"
For any self-reported heartbeat where the monitored
node is the publisher, missing data = ALARM.
Whether Keeper crashes or the publisher breaks, on-call
is paged immediately instead of staring at a gray badge
Alarm Rule: Observer-pushed metric → treat_missing_data = missing · Self-pushed heartbeat → treat_missing_data = breaching
